blocks.text: The anticipation surrounding the 50th Hunger Games reached Cebu as SM J Mall welcomed fans to a special advance screening of The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, bringing the fictional world of Panem closer to the big screen ahead of the film’s November 18, 2026 premiere. Themed around the Second Quarter Quell, the gathering captured the spirit of the franchise, where fashion, identity, and the spectacle of the Games have always been part of its storytelling. Dressing for the Districts The best part of a franchise screening is seeing how far the audience is willing to go, and this one […]...
